summary: Frontend-only public-site testing of the four newly added React-island features on the Astro app: (1) Projects filter with AND-logic + live match count, (2) global Cmd/Ctrl+K command palette, (3) Contact form with live validation + success toast, (4) global image lightbox on /projects and blog posts. All four features work end-to-end on desktop; command palette also verified on mobile via keyboard shortcut. Two very minor cosmetic/spec-alignment notes flagged; no functional bugs.

test_results.projects_filter_initial_state: PASS - [data-testid=project-match-count] reads '7 projects', 7 [data-testid=project-card] rendered, [data-testid=project-filter-all] present, 20 tech chips rendered (astro, bigquery, css, figma, html, javascript, looker, matplotlib, mysql, numpy, pandas, pentaho, python, rapidminer, scikit-learn, seaborn, sqlite, tableau, tailwind, typescript)
test_results.projects_filter_single_tech: PASS - clicking [data-testid=project-filter-python] adds 'chip-active' class, cards filter to 3, count reads '3 projects matching 1 filter'
test_results.projects_filter_AND_logic: PASS - adding [data-testid=project-filter-pandas] keeps cards at 3 (python AND pandas subset), count '3 projects matching 2 filters'
test_results.lightbox_projects_open: PASS - clicking img[data-zoomable][data-gallery=projects] opens [data-testid=lightbox]; 7 zoomable project images detected; counter reads '1 / 7'
test_results.lightbox_zoom_toggle: PASS (behavior) - Lightbox.tsx toggleZoom() updates inline transform: scale() on the image (verified via code review). Note: my initial test compared class attribute which does not change; the zoom is applied via style, not class. Not a bug.
test_results.lightbox_close_esc_and_button: PASS - Escape hides lightbox; [data-testid=lightbox-close] also closes it
test_results.lightbox_blog_article: PASS - opened /blog/why-i-rebuilt-my-website-again, cover image img[data-zoomable][data-gallery=article] opens the same lightbox; Escape closes
test_results.command_palette_filter_and_navigate: PASS - typing 'about' into [data-testid=command-palette-input] filters to 1 item (About / Page); ArrowDown+ArrowUp+Enter navigates to /about
test_results.contact_form_empty_blur_errors: PASS - blurring empty fields shows [data-testid=contact-name-error], contact-email-error, contact-message-error inline
test_results.contact_form_submit_disabled_when_invali: PASS/NOTE - the submit button is disabled while validation errors exist (disabled={sending || invalid}). Errors are surfaced via onBlur (touched) rather than by clicking submit-empty. Spec said 'submitting empty shows inline errors'; effectively the errors do show, just via blur not click. Functional intent is met; consider showing errors on submit click regardless (currently unreachable because button is disabled).
test_results.contact_form_valid_submit_success: PASS - POST /actions/contact returns success; [data-testid=contact-status] toast appears; form fields cleared
test_results.contact_success_toast_text: MINOR - actual text: 'Thanks! Your message has been sent. 🚀' (has trailing rocket emoji). Spec text: 'Thanks! Your message has been sent.' Cosmetic diff; the required substring is present.

action_items: (Optional/cosmetic) Contact success toast: spec asked for exact text 'Thanks! Your message has been sent.' - current implementation appends a rocket emoji. Remove the 🚀 in ContactForm.tsx line 68 if strict spec match is desired.

(Optional UX) ContactForm.tsx disables the submit button while invalid, so a click-on-empty flow can't fire onSubmit. Errors still show on blur, but if the spec expects 'clicking submit on empty form shows errors', either drop the invalid part of the disabled prop or mark all fields touched on any focus/click so errors always appear.
critical_code_review_comments: ProjectsExplorer: chip-active class + AND-filter logic and match-count wording all match spec; empty state guarded.

Lightbox.tsx uses global document-level click delegation on img[data-zoomable], groups by data-gallery, and stores zoom/pan via React state. Clean React 19 island. Zoom is applied via inline transform (style), NOT a class - future tests should assert on style.transform rather than className.
CommandPalette.tsx correctly binds Cmd/Ctrl+K and the 'open-command-palette' window event dispatched by Nav.astro; keyboard navigation and Enter->window.location work.

ContactForm.tsx: submit button is disabled while errors exist, which technically prevents the 'submit empty -> show errors' UX path stated in the spec. Errors do show on blur, so the effect is similar, but consider a `handleSubmit` that flags all fields touched even when the click can't actually fire (or drop `invalid` from the disabled condition).
Contact success message adds ' 🚀' beyond the spec's exact string - cosmetic.

success_rate.frontend: 100% - all four features work; two cosmetic/UX notes only

test_credentials: Not needed - all four features are on the public Astro site.
seed_data_creation: None. The valid contact submission POSTed a message to /actions/contact (persisted by existing backend action).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Astro SSR + React islands. Public URL https://favicon-google.preview.emergentagent.com. Key testids: project-filter-all, project-filter-<tech>, project-match-count, project-card, projects-empty; command-palette, command-palette-input, command-palette-item, nav-search-button; contact-form, contact-{name,email,message}-input, contact-{name,email,message}-error, contact-submit-button, contact-status; lightbox, lightbox-image, lightbox-prev, lightbox-next, lightbox-counter, lightbox-close. Note: Lightbox zoom is applied via inline style.transform (not a class change).
